blocks.title: Bayan
blocks.text: Pipe ke saath kisi bhi nuqte par pipe ke cross-sectional raqbe aur fluid ki speed ka hasil-e-zarb (A v) mustaqil hai. Yeh mustaqil fluid ke fi second volume flow, ya saada alfaz mein flow rate, ke barabar hai: A v = mustaqil = volume / waqt.

Ghair-yaksan size ke pipe se bahta fluid lein; steady-state flow mein zarre ek hi lakeeron par chalte hain (Fig. 5.15). Chhote wuqfe delta t mein tube ke neeche ke sire par fluid velocity v1 se faasla delta x1 tay karta hai: delta x1 = v1 delta t ... (5.15). Agar A1 neeche ke sire ka cross-sectional raqba ho to A1 par tube mein bahne wale fluid ka volume V = A1 delta x1, ya V = A1 v1 delta t. Agar rho1 fluid ki density ho to rangeen hisse (A1 se) mein maujood mass delta m1 = volume x density = A1 v1 delta t x rho1. Isi tarah cross-sectional raqbe A2 ke oopar ke sire se usi waqt delta t mein velocity v2 se chalne wala mass delta m2 = A2 v2 delta t x rho2, jahan rho2 A2 se bahar bahte fluid ki density aur delta m chhota mass zahir karta hai. Agar fluid incompressible aur bahao steady ho to fluid ka mass baqi rehta hai: waqt delta t mein A1 se pipe ke neeche dakhil hota mass usi waqt mein A2 se bahar nikalte mass ke barabar hona chahiye, delta m1 = delta m2 ... (5.16). To A1 v1 delta t x rho1 = A2 v2 delta t x rho2, ya A1 v1 rho1 = A2 v2 rho2 ... (5.17), equation of continuity. Chunke incompressible fluid ke steady flow ke liye density mustaqil hai, equation of continuity ban jati hai A1 v1 = A2 v2 ... (5.18): steady flow mein andar aane ki raftar bahar jane ki raftar ke barabar hai. Yeh equation pipe se bahte fluid ke mass ke baqa ka jawaz deti hai. Euler ne 1752 mein incompressible fluid ke liye bohat si terms ke saath continuity equation hasil ki; baad mein 1954 mein C. Truesdell ne use English se tarjuma kiya (Interesting Fact).

blocks.alt: Mura hua tube neeche ke sire (raqba A1) se oopar ke chaure sire (raqba A2) tak uthta hai. Neeche ke sire mein lambai delta x1 ki rangeen tukri aur oopar ke sire mein chhoti lambai delta x2 ki rangeen tukri hai. Teer v1 aur v2 neeche se andar aur oopar se bahar bahao dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.15: Fluid ka mustaqil bahao (kitab ki Figure 5.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono rangeen tukriyon mein ek hi waqt delta t mein fluid ki barabar mass guzarti hai. Neeche ka sira tang hai, is liye wahan tukri lambi (delta x1 bara) aur speed v1 zyada; oopar sira chaura hai, tukri chhoti aur speed kam: A1 v1 = A2 v2.

blocks.title: Example 5.4
blocks.text: Outlet par 20 mm andaruni diameter ka pani ka hose 60 s mein 30 kg pani nikalta hai. Outlet par pani ki speed nikalein, pani ki density 1000 kg m^-3 aur bahao steady maan kar. Hal: D = 20 mm = 0.02 m, r = D/2 = 0.01 m, m = 30 kg, t = 60 s, rho = 1000 kg m^-3, v = ?. Fi second mass flow m/t = 30 kg / 60 s = 0.5 kg s^-1. Cross-sectional raqba A = pi r^2 = 3.14 x (0.01)^2 = 3.14 x 10^-4 m^2. Equation of continuity se raqbe A se fi second nikalne wala pani ka mass rho A v = mass/second, to v = (mass/second)/(rho A) = 0.5 kg s^-1 / (1000 kg m^-3 x 3.14 x 10^-4 m^2) = 0.5 x 10 / 3.14 = 1.6 m s^-1.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne aakhri jawab '0.6 m' chhapa hai. Magar 0.5 x 10 / 3.14 = 1.59, yaani taqreeban 1.6, aur speed ki unit m s^-1 hai, sirf m nahi. Is liye sahi jawab v = 1.6 m s^-1 hai.

blocks.caption: Continuity equation
rows: delta m1 = A1 v1 delta t rho1
delta m2 = A2 v2 delta t rho2
delta m1 = delta m2 (5.16); A1 v1 rho1 = A2 v2 rho2 (5.17)

blocks.text: Jaise pani nal se girta hai us ki speed barhti hai, to continuity equation ke mutabiq us ka cross-sectional raqba ghatta hai (Tidbits). Equation of continuity arteries aur veins mein khoon ke bahao, dariyaon aur pipes mein pani ke bahao, aur duct aur ventilation systems mein hawa ke bahao par lagti hai (For Your Information).

blocks.prompt: 0.05 m diameter ke pipe se pani 2 m s^-1 se bahta hai jo 0.03 m tak tang hota hai; tang hisse mein velocity nikalein (numerical 5.5). Yeh equation mass ke baqa ki shakal kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: A1 v1 = A2 v2 se v2 = v1 (d1/d2)^2 = 2 x (5/3)^2 = 5.56 m s^-1. Kyunke yeh kisi section mein fi second dakhil hote mass ko nikalte mass ke barabar rakhti hai: steady flow mein incompressible fluid ke liye pipe mein koi mass jama ya ghaib nahi hota.

items: A v = mustaqil = flow rate. delta t mein andar mass = bahar mass: A1 v1 rho1 = A2 v2 rho2 (5.17); incompressible: A1 v1 = A2 v2 (5.18), mass ka baqa (Euler 1752). Example 5.4: 3.14 x 10^-4 m^2 se 0.5 kg s^-1 1.6 m s^-1 deta hai (print 0.6).
